title: The office, the view
logline: Julian's office window, invented from the one sentence: a city, water, a gray sky, and pinned to the window's frame a corner of the Sunday with the dog at the top of the stairs. The page looks out from where the man who read it stood.

panels.composition: An office window looking onto a gray city and water, a corner of a newspaper comic page pinned to the window's frame, a desk's edge below.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, an office window looking onto a gray city and water with a corner of a newspaper comic page pinned to the window's frame and a desk's edge below, no people, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: From where the man who read it stood.
